num_vessels: <int> Total number of vessels to be served at the terminal during the planning horizon.
num_berths: <int> Number of berths available along the quay for vessel mooring.
num_QCs: <int> Total number of quay cranes shared across all berths.
num_subblocks: <int> Total number of yard subblocks available for container storage.
H: <int> Length of the cyclical weekly planning horizon in discrete time steps.
E: <int> Extension length beyond the planning horizon to accommodate vessels whose handling wraps across the weekly boundary.
penalty_cost_coefficient_co: <float> Global cost coefficient that scales yard transportation costs for loading and unloading routes.
QC_capacity_per_timestep: <list[int], length H+E> Maximum number of quay cranes available for use at each time step.
loading_route_lengths_D_L: <list[list[float]], shape [num_subblocks][num_berths]> Distance from each yard subblock to each berth for transporting loading containers.
average_unloading_route_lengths_D_U: <list[float], length num_berths> Average distance from each berth to all yard subblocks for transporting unloading containers.

vessels.loading_containers: <int> Number of containers to be loaded onto the vessel.
vessels.unloading_containers: <int> Number of containers to be unloaded from the vessel.
vessels.reserved_subblocks: <int> Number of distinct yard subblocks that must be reserved for this vessel's containers.
vessels.penalty_cost_coefficient: <float> Per-vessel cost weight applied to deviations between actual and expected service times.
vessels.feasible_time_window: <list[int], length 2> Earliest permissible handling start time step and latest permissible handling end time step for the vessel.
vessels.expected_time_window: <list[int], length 2> Preferred handling start time step and preferred handling end time step within which the vessel ideally receives service.

qc_profiles.handling_time: <int> Number of consecutive time steps required to complete handling under this quay crane profile.
qc_profiles.qc_per_timestep: <list[int], length handling_time> Number of quay cranes assigned to the vessel at each successive time step of handling under this profile.
